content.short: Radius provides a trustless shared sequencing layer powering the next generation of modular blockchains.
content.description: Radius provides a trustless, shared sequencing layer that reduces harmful MEV and censorship while creating economic value for rollups. It introduces an encrypted mempool powered by PVDE (Practical Verifiable Delay Encryption), a ZK-based cryptography scheme. Through PVDE, Radius enables verifiable, trustless transaction sequencing to prevent centralized sequencers from frontrunning, sandwiching, or censoring user transactions, supporting fairer, more predictable processing across supported chains.
content.meta: Radius is a trustless shared sequencing layer that reduces MEV and censorship for rollups. Discover Radius and other RaaS Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: A Sequencer That Cannot Read Your Transaction
resources.tldr: Time-lock puzzles encrypt each transaction until after ordering, which removes the sequencer ability to front-run or censor.
